title: Individualized Support Plan and Daily Paraprofessional Log
brief: A paraprofessional daily log and behavior accommodation plan for a third-grade student with autism spectrum disorder and sensory processing sensitivities, drafted from the student's IEP specifications.

slip.document:
# Individualized Support Plan and Daily Paraprofessional Log
Student: Julian Vance | Grade: 3 | Date: 03/12/2026
Lead Special Education Teacher: Brenda Morris, M.Ed. | Paraprofessional: Keith Miller

## Student Accommodations & Sensory Profile
| Domain | Approved Strategy | Trigger to Avoid |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Auditory | Noise-dampening earmuffs | Sudden high-frequency bells, crowded assemblies |
| Transitions | Visual countdown timer (5-minute warning) | Abrupt schedule changes |
| Seating | Flexible wobble stool at perimeter | Direct center of room surrounded by peers |
| Communication | Picture Exchange (PECS) / Core board | Complex multi-step verbal-only instructions |

## Daily Schedule & Support Record

08:30 - Morning Arrival
Julian arrived agitated due to bus delay. Offended by corridor volume.
- Offered noise-dampening earmuffs immediately upon entering hall
- Guided to quiet corner in Room 104 for a 5-minute sensory regulation break

09:15 - Small Group Reading Instruction
- Placed wobble stool directly in the room center among all reading groups to enhance peer inclusion
- Facilitated phonics match cards with tactile alphabet blocks

10:30 - General Education Math (Inclusion)
- Provided visual timer at desk set for 20 minutes
- Implemented hand-over-hand prompting on manipulatives for two-digit subtraction

11:45 - Cafeteria & Recess Transition
Julian exhibited hand-flapping and verbal vocalizations indicating rising anxiety before line-up.
- Presented lunch choice PECS cards and verified tray selection
- Sensory break provided prior to dismissal

13:15 - Resource Room Social Skills
- Co-led turn-taking board game with peer partner
- Documented 4 unprompted uses of visual schedule board

14:30 - Departure
Julian transitioned to Bus 14 with 1:1 escort. Signed off with transportation aide Mr. Alvarez.

errors.quote: Placed wobble stool directly in the room center among all reading groups to enhance peer inclusion
errors.explanation: The student profile table explicitly designates seating as 'Flexible wobble stool at perimeter' and identifies 'Direct center of room surrounded by peers' as a trigger to avoid. Seating Julian in the center contradicts his approved accommodation.
errors.fix: Placed wobble stool along the classroom perimeter away from crowded group clusters

errors.quote: Sensory break provided prior to dismissal
errors.explanation: The entry records that a sensory break was provided prior to dismissal from the cafeteria/recess transition, but omits the required duration and specific sensory protocol or tool utilized (such as a 5-minute quiet space or deep pressure vest).
errors.fix: 5-minute deep-pressure quiet space sensory break provided prior to dismissal
